title: credential.limit_reached v1
description: A run hits a provider limit. Starts the recovery time. Figures and times only.

seat_id.description: The seat whose run was interrupted.

review_id.description: The review the run was doing, or null.

job_id.description: The job the run was doing, or null.

window.description: The limit window refused, or null when the reply names none.

reset_at.description: The reset time the provider gave, or null.
